items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I was living with Roomful’s baritone player, Doug Schlect

ctx.x: This would have been ‘75 I guess. So I went down to Providence and hung out on the scene with Hamilton a lot. Chris Flory had a quartet, because Scott already had his own band, with a great guitar player by the name of Fred Bates. And with Chuck Riggs as well, who followed him on into New York and everything. And we were sort of the two straight ahead or swing and bebop based jazz bands in Providence, so whatever gigs there were, you know Scott would get all the good ones and we’d sort of pick up the crumbs. But…
Can you explain that? Widespread Depression?
